name: exec
arguments:
const issues=load("qa_issues");
const rows=issues.filter(i=>i.state==="closed").map(i=>`| #${i.issue_number} | ${i.title} | [Review](issue-${i.issue_number}/review.md) | Pending |`).join("\n");
text(await tools.apply_patch(`*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/README.md
+# Proactive Visual QA Review — 2026-10-25
+
+Review in progress. Owner requested one dedicated GPT-6.1 Sol High reviewer per completed frontend issue, fresh screenshot comparisons against tasks/specifications, and independent design critique including flaws in the requirements themselves.
+
+Baseline: \`9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774\`. All 21 completed frontend issues are in scope; #76 remains open/deferred and is excluded. Fresh GitHub bodies and zero-comment discussion counts are preserved in [contracts](contracts/). Review-only work does not change acceptance/status or authorize fixes.
+
+Existing dirty documentation, skills and evidence are preserved. Frontend and index were clean at capture; [baseline.json](baseline.json) records 162 source/test hashes. Screenshots are isolated mock-backed Chromium captures, with muted audio/fake microphone. Production and physical-device claims are outside this evidence.
+
+| Issue | Purpose | Report | Status |
+|---|---|---|---|
+${rows.replace(/\n/g,"\n+")}
+
+The final synthesis will distinguish implementation mismatches, requirement/design flaws, evidence gaps and optional improvements. A green test run or reference match is not by itself a positive design verdict.
*** End Patch`));
